evidenceReview.label: 2 due-diligence areas unavailable

items.label: Registration observed
items.detail: Current registry, WHOIS, or authoritative DNS evidence supports a registered state.

items.label: Expiry date not published
items.detail: A usable publication was collected without a normalised expiry date. Registry policy and renewal state still require manual confirmation.

items.label: No interpreted lock status observed
items.detail: The collected statuses did not contain a recognised client or server lock. This does not prove transfer eligibility or that other policy restrictions are absent.

items.label: Service continuity unresolved
items.detail: The available point-in-time evidence does not establish current web or mail dependencies.

items.label: Contact routing unavailable
items.detail: No usable contact publication was available from the collected sources.

policyChecks.label: Confirm .example eligibility and registration policy
policyChecks.detail: Check current registry and registrar rules for registrant eligibility, reserved names, disputes, documentation, renewal, and transfer before committing funds.

policyChecks.detail: No recognised lifecycle status was retained. Confirm renewal, grace, redemption, restoration, and deletion rules with the current registry or registrar.
policyChecks.provenance: Separately attributed RDAP and WHOIS lifecycle publications

policyChecks.label: Confirm transfer and change-of-control requirements
policyChecks.detail: No recognised lock was retained, but that does not establish transfer eligibility. Confirm authorisation, waiting periods, identity checks, and registrar requirements.

nextSteps: Confirm current registration eligibility, price, and contractual terms with an appropriate registrar or registry.
Review current registry lifecycle and transfer-policy statuses immediately before acting.
Determine whether current DNS, web, mail, and certificate services must be preserved.
Resolve official registry and registrar support channels manually.
Review trade mark, eligibility, dispute, tax, escrow, and legal requirements outside WHOISleuth.
limitations: This workspace organises observed evidence; it does not value a domain or establish that it can be acquired.
Expiry dates, EPP statuses, sale signals, and contact routes can change after collection.
WHOISleuth does not assess legal rights, registry eligibility, registrar terms, escrow, tax, or payment risk.
This local artefact records an analyst review of bounded point-in-time evidence and does not submit, reserve, value, purchase, or transfer a domain.
A reviewed state records completion of the displayed manual checklist, not the accuracy of external statements or a legal, financial, eligibility, or ownership determination.
Refresh authoritative registration and policy evidence immediately before acting.
This packet contains synthetic demonstration data and must not be used as evidence or an acquisition record.
